run_custom_init_isort_check: run the custom_init_isort script in check-only mode to verify import sorting across all diffusers init files
run_custom_init_isort_fix: run the custom_init_isort script to auto-fix import sorting in all diffusers __init__.py files
sort_imports_single_file: sort the _import_structure imports in a single __init__.py file using the sort_imports function
sort_objects_isort_style: sort a list of objects following isort rules with constants first, classes second, functions last
split_code_in_indented_blocks: split source code into indented blocks at a given indent level using start and end prompts
